How it works

You don't write code.
You build a team.

Place agents on a canvas. Give them roles, tools, instructions. Choose how they collaborate. Hit run.

01 Compose agents
02 Structure the team
03 Run & deliver
Think of a finance team.
One agent finds the data, one analyses it, one writes the report. They work in sequence, pass results along — and you receive the output, not the process.

That's Agentivity. You compose the team. They handle the rest.

01

The Canvas

Your visual workspace. Place agents on it, choose how they're structured — see the whole team at a glance. Who does what, in what order, what they produce.

  • Drag-and-drop agent placement
  • Visual topology selection
  • Real-time team overview
02

Agents

Each agent has a role, a set of tools, and instructions you define. A Research Agent searches the web. An Analysis Agent reads the findings. A Writer Agent drafts the report.

Low-code, not no-code Configuring an agent takes care — a clear role, precise instructions, the right tools. Builders love it.
03

Teams & Topologies

Choose your team structure. Each topology defines how agents interact, pass information, and produce results together.

Finance team example — Research Agent → Analysis Agent → Report Agent → your inbox.

Workflow Studio

Agentic and deterministic —
in one flow.

Some steps need intelligence — research, analyse, decide. Others need precision — send, log, publish, trigger. Agentivity handles both.

Most tools do one or the other.
